mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_buy_market_better.mq_task (biz_id, biz_type, event_type, topic, shard_key, payload, status, retry_times, max_retry_times, next_retry_time) VALUES (#{bizId}, #{bizType}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{shardKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryTimes}, #{maxRetryTimes}, #{nextRetryTime})
